---
title: "DataRobot_Cleanup"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(vroom)
library(glue)
library(glmnet)
```

```{r}
train_data <- vroom("train.csv") |>
  select(-casual, -registered) |>
  mutate(count = log(count))
test_data <- vroom("test.csv")
data_robot_predictions <- vroom("DataRobot_Predictions.csv")
```

```{r}
data_robot_predictions <- data_robot_predictions |>
  mutate(count_PREDICTION=exp(count_PREDICTION)) %>%
  bind_cols(., test_data) %>% #Bind predictions with test data
  select(datetime, count_PREDICTION) %>% #Just keep datetime and prediction variables
  rename(count=count_PREDICTION) %>% #rename pred to count (for submission to Kaggle)
  mutate(count=pmax(0, count)) %>% #pointwise max of (0, prediction)
  mutate(datetime=as.character(format(datetime)))

vroom_write(x=data_robot_predictions, file=glue("./Data_Robot_Predictions_Submission.csv"), delim=",")
```
